scientific_description: A fungal disease caused by Venturia inaequalis affecting leaves and fruit, causing olive-green to black velvety spots.
chemical_remedies: ["Captan 50 WP at 2g per liter of water", "Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5g per liter"]
organic_remedies: ["Prune and destroy infected fallen leaves", "Apply 1% neem oil spray periodically", "Ensure proper canopy aeration"]

scientific_description: Fungal infection caused by Alternaria solani, characterized by dark concentric rings forming target-like patterns on older foliage.
chemical_remedies: ["Chlorothalonil at 2ml per liter", "Copper Oxychloride at 3g per liter"]
organic_remedies: ["Maintain crop rotation", "Apply organic mulch around base to prevent soil splash", "Remove lower diseased foliage"]

scientific_description: Foliar disease caused by Cercospora zeae-maydis presenting as rectangular, brown lesions running parallel with leaf veins.
chemical_remedies: ["Azoxystrobin at 1ml per liter", "Pyraclostrobin applied at tassel emergence"]
organic_remedies: ["Plant disease-tolerant hybrid varieties", "Practice conventional tillage to bury infected residue", "Avoid overhead irrigation"]
